description: The key used to look up a dependency: a class, an abstract class or an `InjectionToken`.
A recipe registered under a token: `useClass`, `useValue`, `useFactory` or `useExisting`.
A typed token for values that are not classes (config objects, primitives, functions). Can declare a default with `providedIn` + `factory`.
Collects all providers of a token into an array instead of letting the last one win.
Aliases one token to another so both resolve to the same instance.
Returns `null` when the token has no provider instead of throwing `NG0201`.
